title: TOEIC Reading Mini Mock Test
description: 50 題 · Part 5 (20) + Part 6 (20) + Part 7 (10)。建議一次計時到底，中途不要對答案。

questions.prompt: By the time the external auditors ______ their preliminary review, the finance team had already circulated the revised figures.
questions.explanation: (B) completed — By the time + 過去簡單式，主句用過去完成式（had already circulated）。陷阱：(C) had completed 想誘你把兩個動作都放過去完成，但 by 子句本身是基準時間點，用過去簡單式。

questions.prompt: All visitor access cards ______ to the security desk before employees leave the building for the day.
questions.explanation: (B) must be returned — cards 是被歸還，需被動 must be + p.p.。(A) 主動語意錯（卡片不會自己歸還）。

questions.prompt: ______ the persistent supply delays, the manufacturing team managed to fulfill every order placed in the third quarter.
questions.explanation: (B) Despite — 後面接名詞片語 the persistent supply delays，需介系詞 Despite。陷阱：(A) Although 要接子句、(D) However 要接子句且需標點，(C) Even 單獨不成立。

questions.prompt: The regional manager asked that each branch ______ its quarterly inventory count no later than the 25th.
questions.explanation: (C) submit — ask that + S + (should) 原形，屬要求性動詞的假設語氣，動詞用原形。陷阱：(A) submits 誤用第三人稱單數。

questions.prompt: The proposal was rejected not because of its cost ______ because of the tight timeline it required.
questions.explanation: (C) but — 固定句型 not because of A but because of B（不是因為 A，而是因為 B）。

questions.prompt: Ms. Alvarez, ______ presentation impressed the entire board, has been promoted to director of operations.
questions.explanation: (C) whose — 後接名詞 presentation，表所有格關係代名詞。陷阱：(A) who 之後應接動詞、(B) whom 為受格。

questions.prompt: Employees are reminded to ______ their personal belongings on the labeled shelves, not on the floor of the storage room.
questions.explanation: (B) lay — 及物動詞「放置」（lay–laid–laid），後有受詞 belongings。陷阱：(A) lie 是不及物「躺／位於」，不接受詞。

questions.prompt: The two firms agreed to divide the licensing revenue equally ______ themselves for the duration of the contract.
questions.explanation: (B) between — 雖是分配，但明確是 the two firms 兩方之間，用 between。陷阱：(A) among 用於三者以上；此題故意用「divide...equally」誘你選 among，但主體是「兩家公司」。

questions.prompt: Far ______ applicants applied for the internship this cycle than the department had anticipated.
questions.explanation: (C) fewer — applicants 為可數複數，用 fewer；且 Far fewer... than 為比較句。陷阱：(A) less 用於不可數。

questions.prompt: The maintenance crew will not begin the electrical upgrade ______ the building has been fully evacuated.
questions.explanation: (B) until — 「直到大樓完全淨空前不會開始」，時間點語意用 until。陷阱：(A) unless（除非）語意反了；(C) since、(D) while 皆不合。

questions.prompt: The updated software runs noticeably ______ than the previous version, even on older machines.
questions.explanation: (C) more smoothly — 修飾動詞 runs 需副詞，且句尾 than 需比較級 → more smoothly。陷阱：(A) smooth 為形容詞、(B) 少了比較級。

questions.prompt: To ______ that no attendee is turned away, the organizers have asked all participants to register at least one week in advance.
questions.explanation: (C) ensure — 「確保沒有人被拒於門外」用 ensure（確保某事發生）。陷阱：(A) assure 需接「人」（assure someone）、(B) insure 為投保。

questions.prompt: The keynote speaker, ______ the audience had been eagerly awaiting, arrived twenty minutes behind schedule.
questions.explanation: (B) whom — 關係子句 the audience had been awaiting ___，缺的是 await 的受詞 → 受格 whom。陷阱：(A) who 為主格。

questions.prompt: ______ the two proposals meets the committee's budget requirements, so the search for vendors will continue.
questions.explanation: (B) Neither of — 後句 so the search...will continue（所以繼續找廠商），暗示兩案都不符合 → Neither of。且動詞為單數 meets 也符合 Neither of。陷阱：(A) Either of 語意矛盾。

questions.prompt: The consulting fee is ______ to change without notice, depending on the scope of the engagement.
questions.explanation: (A) subject — 固定搭配 be subject to change（可能變動）。此處 subject 為形容詞。陷阱：(B) subjected 為被動動詞語意不同。

questions.prompt: Sales figures rose sharply in the spring; ______, they declined just as quickly once the promotion ended.
questions.explanation: (B) however — 前後語意轉折（先大漲、後快跌）。陷阱：(A) therefore（因此）、(C) moreover（而且）皆非轉折。

questions.prompt: The committee will announce the winning design ______ all the entries have been reviewed by the panel.
questions.explanation: (A) as soon as — 「所有作品審查完就公布」，時間語意。陷阱：(B) so that（目的）、(C) in case（以防）語意不合。

questions.prompt: Had the shipment been insured, the company ______ the full value of the damaged goods.
questions.explanation: (C) would have recovered — Had + S + p.p. 是與過去事實相反的假設語氣倒裝，主句需 would have + p.p.。

questions.prompt: The instructions clearly state that the equipment should be handled with ______ care during transport.
questions.explanation: (B) considerable — 修飾名詞 care，需形容詞且語意為「相當大的」→ considerable。陷阱：(A) considerate（體貼的）意義不符、(D) consideration 為名詞。

questions.prompt: ______ receiving the customer's complaint, the support team issued a full refund within the hour.
questions.explanation: (B) Upon — Upon + V-ing＝「一……就……」，等同 On receiving。陷阱：(A) Since、(C) While、(D) During 皆不能直接引導此結構語意。

questions.passageText:
To: All Marketing Staff From: Deborah Kwan, Marketing Director Subject: Updated Expense Reporting

Effective the first of next month, all travel-related expenses must be submitted through the new online portal rather than the paper forms we have used until now. The paper system, ______ (21) has served us for over a decade, can no longer keep pace with our reporting volume.

Please note that receipts must be uploaded within five business days of any trip. Claims submitted after this window ______ (22) delayed reimbursement, as they will require additional manager approval.

______ (23) We understand that adjusting to any new system takes time. For that reason, the finance team will hold two walkthrough sessions next week, and attendance is strongly ______ (24) for anyone who travels regularly.

Thank you for your cooperation.
questions.prompt: Select the best answer for blank (21).
questions.explanation: (A) which — 非限定關係子句修飾 The paper system，先行詞為物 → which。陷阱：(D) it 會造成兩個主詞的破碎句。

NOTICE TO ALL TENANTS — Parking Garage Resurfacing

The lower-level parking garage will undergo resurfacing ______ (25) June 3 and June 7. During this period, the lower level will be completely inaccessible to vehicles.

Tenants who normally park below ground may use the overflow lot on Maple Street at no additional charge. ______ (26) Spaces there are limited, so we recommend arriving earlier than usual.

questions.explanation: (C) between — between June 3 and June 7，between...and 固定搭配。陷阱：(A) from 需搭配 to。

questions.passageText:
Email

To: Marcus Bellamy m.bellamy@northgate-events.com From: Priya Nadkarni p.nadkarni@harlow-associates.com Date: October 2 Subject: Autumn Leadership Summit — Venue Concerns

Dear Mr. Bellamy,

I am writing regarding our booking for the Autumn Leadership Summit, scheduled to take place at the Northgate Conference Centre on November 8. As you know, Harlow Associates reserved the Grand Hall and two adjoining breakout rooms back in June, with an expected attendance of 240 delegates.

Two issues have come to my attention. First, when I visited the venue last week, I noticed that the Grand Hall's main projector was not functioning. Our opening keynote depends heavily on a video presentation, so this must be resolved well before the event. Second, our registrations have now climbed to 285 — considerably higher than our original estimate. I am concerned that the Grand Hall, which your website lists as accommodating 250 seated guests, may no longer be adequate.

Could you advise whether a larger space is available for that date? If not, we may need to discuss alternative seating arrangements or, as a last resort, cap our registration. I would appreciate a response by October 6, as we must confirm our catering numbers shortly thereafter.

Best regards, Priya Nadkarni Events Coordinator, Harlow Associates

Notice (posted at the Northgate Conference Centre, October 4)

NORTHGATE CONFERENCE CENTRE — Facility Update

Please be aware of the following changes affecting bookings in November:

The Grand Hall will undergo scheduled audiovisual upgrades from October 20 to October 31. All projection and sound equipment will be replaced with new units. Events booked from November 1 onward will benefit from the upgraded systems at no extra cost.
The Riverside Pavilion, our largest space (seated capacity 350), has recently become available for November following a cancellation. Clients wishing to transfer an existing booking to the Pavilion should contact their account manager. A transfer fee may apply.
The two breakout rooms adjoining the Grand Hall are unaffected and remain available as booked.

For questions, please contact the events office.

Internal Memo

To: Events Team From: Marcus Bellamy Date: October 5 Re: Harlow Associates booking

Team,

Following up on the Harlow Associates summit (Nov 8). I've reviewed their coordinator's concerns and here's how we'll proceed:

The projector issue resolves itself — the Grand Hall's entire AV system is being replaced later this month, so by their event date everything will be new. I'll reassure her on that point directly.

The capacity problem is the real one. At 285 registrations, the Grand Hall won't do. The Riverside Pavilion is now open for November and seats 350, which gives them ample room. I'm going to recommend they transfer. Given that the original shortfall wasn't their fault and they're a repeat client, I've decided we'll waive the transfer fee in this case. Please prepare the paperwork so I can offer this when I reply to her tomorrow.

One more thing: their breakout rooms stay exactly as they are — those aren't affected by any of this.

Thanks, Marcus
questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of Ms. Nadkarni's email?

options.text: To cancel a previously confirmed booking
To raise concerns about a venue and request a solution
To request a refund for a faulty projector
To confirm the final catering numbers for an event

questions.explanation: (B) — 主旨題。整封信在反映場地兩個問題（投影機故障、人數超出）並請對方提供解方。(D) catering 只是附帶時間依據，非主旨。
